title: Split Stripe webhook secrets
working_tree_status: dirty shared worktree; owned route and test surfaces preserved
goal: Split ticketing and subscriptions webhooks onto domain-specific STRIPE_*_WEBHOOK_SECRET env vars
acceptance_criteria: Domain-specific Stripe webhook secrets in use

evidence: Five-route secret-boundary contract passed: subscription, ticketing, photos, marketplace, and music royalties each reference only their endpoint-specific secret and do not reference the generic STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

progress.summary: Verified strict endpoint-specific Stripe webhook secrets without generic fallback.
next_steps: Release provisions each endpoint secret independently and updates Stripe CLI forwarding commands for local smoke tests.

checkpoints.summary: Removed generic Stripe webhook-secret fallback from the in-scope handlers and verified strict endpoint boundaries.
Verified strict endpoint-specific Stripe webhook secrets without generic fallback.

handoffs: Release: provision the five named endpoint-specific secrets. The generic STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is no longer accepted by these routes.
